items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: especially with Helen Humes, we used to go to Europe every year for George Wein.

ctx.x: What kind of traveling in other parts of the world have you been able to do.

Oh, when I was with singers I did quite a bit of travel, especially with Helen Humes, we used to go to Europe every year for George Wein. But she passed away in I guess it was ‘81. So I don’t go out too much now. If I go out it’s for a couple of days or so. You know, I don’t want anything steady. I had enough of steady work.
Yeah? I’m glad to hear that you can take what you want.
